text:
lina: Heads up — SolsticeCare sent their renewal questionnaire and flagged three blockers: (1) embeddings retention policy, (2) BYOK across deployments, (3) request to see SOC2 evidence for their auditors. We need crisp one-line answers + links. Can we turn this around by EOD?

cory-cs: I got this. Quick product recap: default embeddings retention = 90 days; Dedicated/Private can be contracted to alternate windows; deletion via API available and audit logged.

owen-ops: Ops note: for Dedicated/Private we can set retention at provisioning (30/90/365). Deletion is a per-tenant operation that emits an audit event and a ticket. For Hosted, retention is our default unless deeded otherwise in contract.

lina: can you both draft the exact lines for the form? one short sentence each + doc links.

cory-cs: Draft embedding line: "Redwood retains customer-generated embeddings for up to 90 days by default; customers may request earlier deletion via API or account team. Contractual retention terms can be set for Dedicated and Private deployments. See https://internal.redwood/docs/privacy/embeddings-retention."

meera-legal: For SOC2 please use: "SOC2 Type II report available under NDA; auditor access coordinated via the account team and scoped per request." Keep it high-level.

owen-ops: BYOK blurb: "BYOK supported on Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted BYOK is supported in scoped cases; contact your account team for eligibility. See https://internal.redwood/docs/onboarding/byok for onboarding steps."

cory-cs: ops snippet to paste into appendix: ```
1) Customer provides KMS key identifier (ARN/resource ID)
2) CS creates provisioning ticket with retention and key info
3) Ops binds key to tenant and verifies access
4) Rotation and audit windows agreed in ticket
```

meera-legal: tweak: replace any use of "available" with "supported" and add: "Evidence sharing subject to NDA and scope."

lina: perfect. cory 1 can you paste those three one-liners into the questionnaire and link the doc? owen 1 can you include the ops snippet in the shared doc? meera 1 final sign-off before i send.

docbot: New doc created: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/solstice-1809999999 (view-only).

cory-cs: pasted lines + API deletion example: 
```
DELETE /v1/customers/{id}/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

owen-ops: added the ops onboarding snippet and sample KMS JSON: ```
{ "kms": { "provider": "aws", "key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd" } }
```

meera-legal: LGTM. Reminder: don't include retention guarantees in SOC2 answer; funnel contractual retention to DPA addendum.

lina: sending to customer now. Also proposing a 6-12 month Dedicated pilot with fixed pricing to mitigate renewal risk around residency. owen 1 can you join a 30m call tomorrow to walk their infra?

owen-ops: yes.

docbot: Shared doc updated: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/solstice-1809999999 (updated by cory-cs).

lina: done 1 form sent. closing thread; follow-ups in the doc. :white_check_mark:
